fullContentHtml:
IERT Prayagraj Diploma Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

IERT Prayagraj Diploma Admit Card 2026. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. The last date to apply is 30/04/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 05/02/2026
  • Last Date : 30/04/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 30/04/2026
  • Engineering Diploma Exam Date : 30/06/2026
  • Other Courses Exam Date : 03/07/2026
  • Admit Card Released Date : 20/06/2026
  • Result Declared Date : As Per Schedule
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here
  • How to Download Admit Card : Watch Video

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 05/02/2026
  • Last Date : 30/04/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 30/04/2026
  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 1350/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 1350/-
  • Engineering/Technology Diploma Three Year (6 Semester) : Class 10 High School with Science / Math as a Compulsory Subject.Age Limit : Minimum 14 Years as on 01/07/2026
  • Management Diploma Two Year (4 Semester) : 10+2 Intermediate Exam with English and Hindi as Compulsory Subject in 10+2 or High School Level Exam.
  • Post Diploma in Computer Application One & Half Year (3 Semester) : Diploma in Any Stream with Physics and Math as a Subject in 10+2 Intermediate Exam in Any Recognized Board in India.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
